blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is “terribly excited” about the United States-led Pax Silica initiative in Pampanga. The chief executive sees the project as an opportunity for the Philippines to expand its role in the global semiconductor industry. He believes Pax Silica will take the country beyond manufacturing and into research, design and development. “We were already talking about moving up the value chain, and not just fabricating the actual semiconductor chips, but moving into R&D (research and development), moving into design and development,” Marcos told Forbes magazine chair and editor-in-chief Steve Forbes.
